compare_on: grain size, film uniformity and efficiency at matched coating conditions
summary: Spin coating gives larger grains but poorer uniformity, vapor-assisted growth gives micrometer-scale grains, and blade coating trades grain quality for throughput; none of the three addresses moisture sensitivity.

compare_on: hysteresis suppression versus open-circuit voltage gain
summary: Hysteresis suppression improves measurement reliability while PEAI passivation raises the open-circuit voltage; both were demonstrated on single devices with a fixed growth route.

compare_on: degradation mechanism, stability metric and encapsulation strategy
summary: Stability metrics are defined at the device-stack level, moisture pathways are mapped for the lattice, and epoxy encapsulation extends the T80 lifetime; the three works use different humidity conditions.
Certified efficiency progress is tracked at the community level and provides the upper bound against which device results are compared.

compare_on: which structural quantity each technique can resolve
summary: Lattice strain is quantified by X-ray diffraction, and the wider characterization toolkit is reviewed; neither work couples strain to grain-boundary chemistry.
Low-light indoor operation is evaluated separately from one-sun performance, which is the condition used throughout this work.
